verdict.rationale: Poly ships an in-product agent that can summarize and explain your files, which covers AI-generated insights from your own data. It can also run multi-step tasks such as reading, searching and organizing. Poly additionally builds a 'second brain' memory from your files. Missing for 10: documented proactive AI suggestions (unprompted recommendations or insights), depth of the insight features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product insight quality.
